class.description: Custom pure-pursuit controller, converted from motion_controller's standalone pure_pursuit_motion_planner_node into a real nav2_core::Controller plugin for controller_server's FollowPath. Preserves the original heading/lookahead/rotate-in-place control law and the /pd/goal_reached, /pd/next_pose, /pd/lookahead_marker topics diy_waypoint_sequencer and RViz already depend on.
